character_spans.text: Furniture / Living Room Furniture / Chairs & Seating / Accent Chairs

this armchair creates an essential spot to sit and enjoy a good book or catch up on your favorite show . it 's built with a solid and engineered wood frame and has tapered legs , rolled arms , and a barrel-like back to create a traditional silhouette . the faux leather upholstery is filled with foam and has a spring seat construction for just the right amount of support that bounces back . a nailhead trim lines the front of the arms to add a hint of embellishment to the armchair .
productcare : wipe clean with a dry cloth
cleaningcode : x : clean by lightly brushing and/or vacuuming to remove dust
